title: Bring in the music you already have.
lead: Sonarche reads the folder, copies what it finds into the ark, and keeps the existing tags. Your original files stay where they are.
hint: Nothing is moved: the ark gets a copy.
foundNoneHint: Sonarche found no audio files here. The right folder is the one holding the albums.
truncated: Very large folder: the count stops at 200,000 entries, there may be more.
unplayableKept: They are imported anyway: their tags still count, and they keep their place in their album.
cancelledDetail: Stopped mid-copy. Already in the ark: {{landed}}.
cancelledNothing: Stopped before anything came in. The library is unchanged.
doneDetail_one: {{count, number}} folder added to the ark.
doneDetail_other: {{count, number}} folders added to the ark.
shrinkingWhy: Oversized covers get a display version. The original is kept beside it.
doneRenditions_one: {{count, number}} cover got a display version.
doneRenditions_other: {{count, number}} covers got a display version.

scan.name: Scan
scan.body: Your folder is read, never changed. Sonarche counts what it can read and shows you the verdict before anything starts — nothing moves without your go.

copy.name: Copy
copy.body: Every track is copied into the ark and filed by artist and album, from its tags. When a title is missing from the tags, Sonarche takes it from the filename rather than lose it.

covers.name: Covers
covers.body: The cover comes from the folder, or from the image embedded in the files themselves. Oversized images get a display version, with the original kept beside it.

after.name: What comes next
after.body: The import invents nothing: your existing tags are kept as they are, with no online lookup. To identify albums and fill missing years, genres or covers, run the alignment — offered at the bottom of this page.

recap.collections_one: {{count, number}} folder came in as a collection: its tracks never agreed on one record, so no tracklist is asked of it. Changeable on its page.
recap.collections_other: {{count, number}} folders came in as collections: their tracks never agreed on one record, so no tracklist is asked of them. Changeable on their pages.
recap.clean: Everything is filled in: year, genre, artwork, tracklist.
recap.alignHint: These albums arrive without a MusicBrainz identity. The alignment can identify them and fill the gaps — year, genre and covers included.

grouping.label: What makes an album
grouping.intro: Sonarche has to decide which tracks belong to the same record. You say what decides.
grouping.folderWhy: Tags do not count: a folder of 40 tracks by 40 artists makes one record, named after the folder — filed as a collection, so no tracklist is asked of it.
grouping.folderFor: For a collection already filed record by record.
grouping.tagsWhy: A folder holding two records makes two. But if the files carry no album tag they all group together anyway, and the result matches the first choice.
grouping.tagsFor: For a catch-all folder whose files are properly tagged.
grouping.tracksWhy: Every file comes in on its own, with its title, its artist and its cover. The only choice that invents no record.
grouping.tracksFor: For tracks picked up one by one.
grouping.suggested: Suggested here: one folder holds {{count}} tracks — more than a record has.

again.done: This folder was already imported on {{when}}.
again.doneHint: Directories already taken on are skipped: only what is new comes in. Nothing will be duplicated.
again.stopped: An import of this folder was stopped on {{when}}.
again.stoppedHint: Pick it up whenever: what already landed is kept, only the rest gets copied.

category.label: Category
category.hint: Applied to everything this import brings in. Context — game or film soundtrack — not musical style.

undo.title: Take “{{name}}” back out of the ark?
undo.counting: Counting what this import still has in the ark…
undo.countFailed: Could not count what this import still has in the ark. Try again in a moment.
undo.tracks_one: {{count, number}} track will be removed from the ark, file included.
undo.tracks_other: {{count, number}} tracks will be removed from the ark, files included.
undo.albumsRemoved_one: {{count, number}} album disappears entirely, artwork with it.
undo.albumsRemoved_other: {{count, number}} albums disappear entirely, artwork with them.
undo.albumsKept_one: {{count, number}} album loses some of its tracks and stays on the shelf.
undo.albumsKept_other: {{count, number}} albums lose some of their tracks and stay on the shelf.
undo.playlistEntries_one: {{count, number}} playlist entry goes with them.
undo.playlistEntries_other: {{count, number}} playlist entries go with them.
undo.edits: Anything done to these tracks since — fixed tags, replaced artwork, genres, a place in a playlist — does not come back.
undo.originals: Your original files are untouched: the import only ever copied them. You can import this folder again whenever you like.
undo.nothingLeft: This import has nothing left in the ark. Taking it back out removes nothing — the folder is simply forgotten.
undo.failedToast: The removal did not go through
undo.subtitle: Taken back out: nothing from this import is in the library any more.
